findings.title: The text asks for administrator rights
findings.advice: Steplet never gives a task administrator rights, so a step that needs them will fail.
findings.quote: If you run this by hand outside Steplet, you may need `sudo apt install build-essential` first; the agent does not need it.

findings.title: A command runs the repository's own code
findings.advice: Tests, builds and scripts run code from the repository. Steplet runs them only inside the fence.
